name: openseat
description: フードコートの座席順番待ちシステム

scripts.typecheck: tsc --build && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.sim.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.server: pnpm --filter @openseat/core build && pnpm --filter @openseat/server build && node apps/server/dist/src/main.js
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:arch && pnpm check:links
scripts.build:apps: pnpm --filter @openseat/core build && pnpm --filter @openseat/shared build && pnpm --filter @openseat/server build && pnpm --filter @openseat/web build
